caption:
Long flights and unfamiliar hotel beds. Every morning on the road, Momo's back and hips feel stiff.

While travelling, a short routine every day often feels easier on the body than doing nothing and then one big session.

Hybi's hotel-room Pilates, on a towel: cat-cow 8 times, pelvic tilts 10, bridge holding 3 seconds for 10 reps, and side-lying leg lifts, 10 each side. About 10 minutes all up.

Leg numbness, a sore and swollen calf after a flight, or no change after two weeks is worth getting checked. Clinical Pilates at Hybrid Physio can help you build a routine. Book online via the link in bio
